{{Top|leg}}
The '''Master Historian''' was a title given to the head of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] Historian Corps. [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] held this position at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
